description: Image Description: The image displays a simple, stylized representation of an hourglass. It consists of two symmetrical, teardrop-shaped sections connected at their narrowest points, forming an elongated figure-eight shape. The top and bottom portions are rounded and bulbous, tapering inward to meet at the center, which is the narrowest part of the structure. The entire figure is rendered in a solid black color against a plain white background, with no additional details such as sand or markings.
